G4300.def: from «4253» and «2964»; to ratify previously:--confirm before.

G4301.def: from «4253» and «2983»; to take in advance, i.e. (literally) eat before others have an opportunity; (figuratively) to anticipate, surprise:--come aforehand, overtake, take before.

G4302.def: from «4253» and «3004»; to say beforehand, i.e. predict, forewarn:--foretell, tell before.

G4303.def: from «4253» and «3143»; to be a witness in advance i.e. predict:--testify beforehand.

G4305.def: from «4253» and «3309»; to care (anxiously) in advance:--take thought beforehand.

G4306.def: from «4253» and «3539»; to consider in advance, i.e. look out for beforehand (actively, by way of maintenance for others; middle voice by way of circumspection for oneself):--provide (for).

G4307.def: from «4306»; forethought, i.e. provident care or supply:--providence, provision.

G4308.def: from «4253» and «3708»; to behold in advance, i.e. (actively) to notice (another) previously, or (middle voice) to keep in (one's own) view:--foresee, see before.

G4309.def: from «4253» and «3724»; to limit in advance, i.e. (figuratively) predetermine:--determine before, ordain, predestinate.

G4310.def: from «4253» and «3958»; to undergo hardship previously:--suffer before.

G4311.def: from «4253» and «3992»; to send forward, i.e. escort or aid in travel:--accompany, bring (forward) on journey (way), conduct forth.

G4312.def: from a compound of «4253» and «4098»; falling forward, i.e. headlong (figuratively, precipitate):--heady, rash(-ly).

G4313.def: from «4253» and «4198»; to precede (as guide or herald):--go before.

G4314.def: a strengthened form of «4253»; a preposition of direction; forward to, i.e. toward (with the genitive case, the side of, i.e. pertaining to; with the dative case, by the side of, i.e. near to; usually with the accusative case, the place, time, occasion, or respect, which is the destination of the relation, i.e. whither or for which it is predicated):--about, according to , against, among, at, because of, before, between, (where-)by, for, × at thy house, in, for intent, nigh unto, of, which pertain to, that, to (the end that), × together, to (you) -ward, unto, with(-in). In the comparative case, it denotes essentially the same applications, namely, motion towards, accession to, or nearness at

G4315.def: from «4253» and «4521»; a fore-sabbath, i.e. the Sabbath-eve:--day before the sabbath. Compare «3904».

G4316.et: from (4314) and a derivative of (58) (mean to harangue)
G4316.def: from «4314» and a derivative of «58» (mean to harangue); to address, i.e. salute by name:--call.

G4317.def: from «4314» and «71»; to lead towards, i.e. (transitively) to conduct near (summon, present), or (intransitively) to approach:--bring, draw near.

G4319.def: from «4314» and «154»; to ask repeatedly (importune), i.e. solicit:--beg.

G4320.def: from «4314» and «305»; to ascend farther, i.e. be promoted (take an upper (more honorable) seat):--go up.

G4322.def: from «4314» and «378»; to fill up further, i.e. furnish fully:--supply.

G4323.def: from «4314» and «394»; to lay up in addition, i.e. (middle voice and figuratively) to impart or (by implication) to consult:--in conference add, confer.

G4324.def: from «4314» and «546»; to menace additionally:--i.e. threaten further.

G4325.def: from «4314» and «1159»; to expend additionally:--spend more.

G4326.def: from «4314» and «1189»; to require additionally, i.e. want further:--need.

G4327.def: from «4314» and «1209»; to admit (to intercourse, hospitality, credence, or (figuratively) endurance); by implication, to await (with confidence or patience):--accept, allow, look (wait) for, take.

G4328.def: from «4314» and dokeuo (to watch); to anticipate (in thought, hope or fear); by implication, to await:--(be in) expect(-ation), look (for), when looked, tarry, wait for.

G4329.def: from «4328»; apprehension (of evil); by implication, infliction anticipated:--expectation, looking after.

G4330.def: from «4314» and «1439»; to permit further progress:--suffer.

G4331.def: from «4314» and «1448»; to approach near:--come nigh.

G4332.et: from a compound of (4314) and the base of (1476)
G4332.def: from a compound of «4314» and the base of «1476»; to sit near, i.e. attend as a servant:--wait at.

G4333.def: from «4314» and «2038»; to work additionally, i.e. (by implication) acquire besides:--gain.

G4334.def: from «4314» and «2064» (including its alternate); to approach, i.e. (literally) come near, visit, or (figuratively) worship, assent to:--(as soon as he) come (unto), come thereunto, consent, draw near, go (near, to, unto).

G4335.def: from «4336»; prayer (worship); by implication, an oratory (chapel):--X pray earnestly, prayer.

G4336.def: from «4314» and «2172»; to pray to God, i.e. supplicate, worship:--pray (X earnestly, for), make prayer.

G4337.def: from «4314» and «2192»; (figuratively) to hold the mind (3563 implied) towards, i.e. pay attention to, be cautious about, apply oneself to, adhere to:--(give) attend(-ance, -ance at, -ance to, unto), beware, be given to, give (take) heed (to unto); have regard.

G4338.def: from «4314» and a derivative of «2247»; to peg to, i.e. spike fast:--nail to.

G4339.def: from the alternate of «4334»; an arriver from a foreign region, i.e. (specially), an acceder (convert) to Judaism ("proselyte"):--proselyte.

G4340.def: from «4314» and «2540»; for the occasion only, i.e. temporary:--dur-(eth) for awhile, endure for a time, for a season, temporal.

G4341.def: middle voice from «4314» and «2564»; to call toward oneself, i.e. summon, invite:--call (for, to, unto).

G4342.def: from «4314» and «2594»; to be earnest towards, i.e. (to a thing) to persevere, be constantly diligent, or (in a place) to attend assiduously all the exercises, or (to a person) to adhere closely to (as a servitor):--attend (give self) continually (upon), continue (in, instant in, with), wait on (continually).

G4344.et: neuter of a presumed compound of (4314) and (2776)
G4344.def: neuter of a presumed compound of «4314» and «2776»; something for the head, i.e. a cushion:--pillow.

G4345.def: from «4314» and «2820»; to give a common lot to, i.e. (figuratively) to associate with:--consort with.

G4346.def: from a compound of «4314» and «2827»; a leaning towards, i.e. (figuratively) proclivity (favoritism):--partiality.

G4347.def: from «4314» and «2853»; to glue to, i.e. (figuratively) to adhere:--cleave, join (self).

G4348.def: from «4350»; a stub, i.e. (figuratively) occasion of apostasy:--offence, stumbling(-block, (-stone)).

G4349.def: from «4350»; a stumbling, i.e. (figuratively and concretely) occasion of sin:--offence.

G4350.def: from «4314» and «2875»; to strike at, i.e. surge against (as water); specially, to stub on, i.e. trip up (literally or figuratively):--beat upon, dash, stumble (at).

G4351.def: from «4314» and «2947»; to roll towards, i.e. block against:--roll (to).

G4352.et: from (4314) and a probable derivative of (2965) (meaning to kiss, like a dog licking his master's hand)
G4352.def: from «4314» and a probable derivative of «2965» (meaning to kiss, like a dog licking his master's hand); to fawn or crouch to, i.e. (literally or figuratively) prostrate oneself in homage (do reverence to, adore):--worship.

G4354.def: from «4314» and «2980»; to talk to, i.e. converse with:--speak to (with).

G4355.def: from «4314» and «2983»; to take to oneself, i.e. use (food), lead (aside), admit (to friendship or hospitality):--receive, take (unto).

G4357.def: from «4314» and «3306»; to stay further, i.e. remain in a place, with a person; figuratively, to adhere to, persevere in:--abide still, be with, cleave unto, continue in (with).

G4358.et: from (4314) and a derivative of the same as (3730) (meaning to tie [anchor] or lull)
G4358.def: from «4314» and a derivative of the same as «3730» (meaning to tie (anchor) or lull); to moor to, i.e. (by implication) land at:--draw to the shore.

G4359.def: from «4314» and «3784»; to be indebted additionally:--over besides.

G4360.et: from (4314) and a form of ochtheo (to be vexed with something irksome)
G4360.def: from «4314» and a form of ochtheo (to be vexed with something irksome); to feel indignant at:--be grieved at.

G4361.def: from «4314» and the same as «3983»; hungering further, i.e. intensely hungry:--very hungry.

G4362.def: from «4314» and «4078»; to fasten to, i.e. (specially), to impale (on a cross):--crucify.

G4363.def: from «4314» and «4098»; to fall towards, i.e. (gently) prostrate oneself (in supplication or homage), or (violently) to rush upon (in storm):--beat upon, fall (down) at (before).

G4364.def: middle voice from «4314» and «4160»; to do forward for oneself, i.e. pretend (as if about to do a thing):--make as though.

G4365.def: from «4314» and «4198»; to journey towards, i.e. approach (not the same as «4313»):--go before.

G4366.def: from «4314» and «4486»; to tear towards, i.e. burst upon (as a tempest or flood):--beat vehemently against (upon).

G4367.def: from «4314» and «5021»; to arrange towards, i.e. (figuratively) enjoin:--bid, command.

G4368.def: feminine of a derivative of «4291»; a patroness, i.e. assistant:--succourer.

G4369.def: from «4314» and «5087»; to place additionally, i.e. lay beside, annex, repeat:--add, again, give more, increase, lay unto, proceed further, speak to any more.

G4370.def: from «4314» and «5143» (including its alternate); to run towards, i.e. hasten to meet or join:--run (thither to, to).

G4371.et: from a presumed derivative of a compound of (4314) and (5315)
G4371.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of «4314» and «5315»; something eaten in addition to bread, i.e. a relish (specially, fish; compare «3795»):--meat.

G4372.def: from «4253» and a derivative of «4969»; previously (recently) slain (fresh), i.e. (figuratively) lately made:--new.

G4374.def: from «4314» and «5342» (including its alternate); to bear towards, i.e. lead to, tender (especially to God), treat:--bring (to, unto), deal with, do, offer (unto, up), present unto, put to.

G4375.et: from a presumed compound of (4314) and (5368)
G4375.def: from a presumed compound of «4314» and «5368»; friendly towards, i.e. acceptable:--lovely.

G4376.def: from «4374»; presentation; concretely, an oblation (bloodless) or sacrifice:--offering (up).

G4377.def: from «4314» and «5455»; to sound towards, i.e. address, exclaim, summon:--call unto, speak (un-)to.

G4378.et: from a comparative of (4314) and cheo (to pour)
G4378.def: from a comparative of «4314» and cheo (to pour); a shedding forth, i.e. affusion:--sprinkling.

G4379.def: from «4314» and psauo (to touch); to impinge, i.e. lay a finger on (in order to relieve):--touch.

G4380.def: from «4381»; to favor an individual, i.e. show partiality:--have respect to persons.

G4381.def: from «4383» and «2983»; an accepter of a face (individual), i.e. (specially), one exhibiting partiality:--respecter of persons.

G4382.def: from «4381»; partiality, i.e. favoritism:--respect of persons.

G4383.def: from «4314» and ops (the visage, from «3700»); the front (as being towards view), i.e. the countenance, aspect, appearance, surface; by implication, presence, person:--(outward) appearance, × before, countenance, face, fashion, (men's) person, presence.

G4384.def: from «4253» and «5021»; to pre-arrange, i.e. prescribe:--before appoint.

G4385.def: from «4253» and teino (to stretch); to protend, i.e. tie prostrate (for scourging):--bind.

G4386.et: neuter of (4387) as adverb (with or without the art.)
G4386.def: neuter of «4387» as adverb (with or without the article); previously:--before, (at the) first, former.

G4388.def: middle voice from «4253» and «5087»; to place before, i.e. (for oneself) to exhibit; (to oneself) to propose (determine):--purpose, set forth.

G4389.et: middle voice from (4253) and the base of (5157)
G4389.def: middle voice from «4253» and the base of «5157»; to turn forward for oneself, i.e. encourage:--exhort.

G4390.def: from «4253» and «5143» (including its alternate); to run forward, i.e. outstrip, precede:--outrun, run before.

G4391.def: from «4253» and «5225»; to exist before, i.e. (adverbially) to be or do something previously:--+ be before(-time).

G4392.def: from a compound of «4253» and «5316»; an outward showing, i.e. pretext:--cloke, colour, pretence, show.

G4393.def: from «4253» and «5342»; to bear forward, i.e. produce:--bring forth.

G4395.def: from «4396»; to foretell events, divine, speak under inspiration, exercise the prophetic office:--prophesy.

G4396.def: from a compound of «4253» and «5346»; a foreteller ("prophet"); by analogy, an inspired speaker; by extension, a poet:--prophet.

G4397.def: from «4396»; pertaining to a foreteller ("prophetic"):--of prophecy, of the prophets.

G4398.def: feminine of «4396»; a female foreteller or an inspired woman:--prophetess.

G4399.def: from «4253» and «5348»; to get an earlier start of, i.e. anticipate:--prevent.
